Keyboard and Screen Reader Friendly Contact Map

Skip to office directory


This map shows Virginia’s counties grouped into seven Office of Drinking Water field-office regions:
Abingdon (AFO), Culpeper (CFO), Danville (DFO), Lexington (LFO), Richmond (RFO),
Southeast Virginia (SEVFO), and the Central Office (administrative). Each region is identified on
the graphic; the directory below provides addresses, phone, fax, and email contacts for each office.

  • AFO — Abingdon Field Office (Southwest)
  • CFO — Culpeper Field Office (Northern/Central Piedmont)
  • DFO — Danville Field Office (South‑Central)
  • LFO — Lexington Field Office (Valley/West‑Central)
  • RFO — Richmond Field Office (East‑Central)
  • SEVFO — Southeast Virginia Field Office (Tidewater)
  • Central Office — Administration (Richmond)
